concepts.name: 01-tidal-clearings
concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished wide 16:9 game main-menu concept image for Glass Tide. The two supplied images are STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCES ONLY, not images to overwrite: match their oblique game camera, clear pale turquoise shallow water, pearl-silt floor, translucent glass-leaf flora, lilac/coral reeds, ivory perforated shell structures, small ochre-hooded survivor with dark legs and teal kelp mantle. Keep the world tactile and luminous with soft lilac daylight. This is a playable physical menu: the survivor walks freely from a neutral spot into one of TWO clear, generously sized ground selection zones. Required choices exactly "SURVIVAL" and "MOTION HUNT", each legible above or beside its own ground zone. Supporting text exactly "Survive the sentinels" and "Collect the seed. Reach an exit." Header text "GLASS TIDE". Small footer text "Move to choose · Hold 0.85s · Enter to confirm". Show one incomplete amber/pearl progress ring around the selected zone to suggest dwell confirmation. Keep all type clean, readable, restrained and integrated into matte pearl membranes. No conventional rectangular website cards, no browser chrome, no gameplay timer, no health/oxygen bars, no weapons, no giant human portrait, no extra modes, no mystical runes. Both choices must be reachable on connected dry/silt shallows without jumping or swimming. Original design, commercial game art direction; the landscape should fill the entire screen. CONCEPT 1 — TIDAL CLEARINGS: A serene open wetland clearing. Two broad almost-flat nacre and sand ovals lie left and right of a small central neutral sandbar, framed lightly by low translucent shell flowers and coral reed islands. The choices are grounded circular ripples/stepping clearings, NOT gates or large structures. Very generous negative space in the middle. Survivor positioned on the edge of the right clearing with a partial amber ring underfoot. Text appears on small subtly floating pearl leaf labels over each clearing. Shallow water connects the paths naturally. Make the two zones unmistakable even at thumbnail size. Calm, airy, the closest to the currently playable Glass Tide terrain.

CONCEPT 3 — THE EXPEDITION NURSERY: An intimate living field station grown from one huge open pearlescent shell and transparent leaf canopy, embedded in a shallow wetland. View obliquely down into its open interior. Inside, left and right are two low organic basin-pedestals on an ivory ribbed floor connected by walkable silt. Left displays a small amber-core sentinel specimen safely folded, right displays a luminous life-support seed. These specimens explain the two modes visually. Each pedestal has a broad recessed floor selection circle in front, accessible to the small ochre survivor standing near center. Labels are neatly grown matte membranes above the pedestals, high contrast dark teal serif. Root veins fill around the right floor circle as its dwell indicator. This is a spacious physical shelter, not a screen close-up, HUD or inventory panel. Water and glass flora visible beyond the shelter, tactile asymmetry, warm amber details, no conventional buttons.
